description: This PHP file defines the 'Setting' controller class for the startup sequence in an OpenCart e-commerce system. It initializes store configuration based on the request's hostname, retrieves relevant store settings, and configures URL and timezone settings.

classes.name: Setting
classes.description: Controller class responsible for initializing store settings, URL, and timezone during startup.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method that performs store hostname resolution, loads settings, sets URL and timezone configuration.
